body:
# BarisKeserTools-MC

**BarisKeserTools** is a staff/admin plugin that brings together useful commands to ease server management and performance while offering various destructive entertainments for your server. It 100% supports forks like **Paper, Spigot, and Purpur**.

## 🔥 What does it do?
This plugin actually combines two different philosophies: Destruction (Airstrikes) and Order (Mass cleanup). Thanks to the built-in auto-updater within the plugin itself, it always fetches the latest version from Github and installs it on the server upon the next startup.

### 📜 Main Features & Commands (All require the `bariskesertools.admin` permission)

* **/havasaldirisi [tnt-amount] [height] [explosion-time] [shape] [damage]**
    This is the main starting point of the plugin. It gives you a fishing rod with a special enchantment. When you cast the rod anywhere, you can launch a massive airstrike from the sky to the ground, drawing patterns such as `star`, `orbital`, `line`, `rain`, or `circle`.

* **/chunk-yiyici [power between 20-500]**
    Allows you to cast a special fishing rod that creates a straight drill effect with a sequential TNT drill, starting from the surface and exploding all the way down to Bedrock (-64). You can sweep away an entire chunk to the very bottom. The power setting expands the explosion radius.

* **/tntsil**
    Destroys all primed TNTs waiting to explode in the world. It prevents massive lag crises in seconds, which can occur especially after gigantic airstrikes.

* **/itemsil**
    Deletes all dropped objects/items lying on the ground. It is aimed at preventing lag.

* **/eşyayahasarver [amount]** & **/tum-envantere-hasar-ver-rasgele**
    Designed for players to test their own item durability or for special trolling purposes. You can apply random durability damage to a specific hand item or to all the armor in your inventory.

* **/bariskesertools <updatecheck|update|commands>**
    Runs the auto-updater to check for new versions or displays the plugin command list on the screen.

### ⚙️ Compatibility
Since it is compiled with **Java 17** with a philosophy of backward compatibility;
It works completely flawlessly on **all major versions** between `1.20, 1.20.1, 1.20.4, 1.20.6` and `1.21, 1.21.1, 1.21.4`!
